visualContract.layoutPolicy: Command is cmdk, not a Menu or selected-value picker: Input query, active option highlight and Item onSelect execution remain distinct. Native command frame 14px corners/4px inset are retained with explicit 28px minimum row,36px search role,300px scroll maximum and 384px palette maximum. Actual Input wraps InputGroup and addon; its command-input slot needs explicit flex:1 and nowrap on that delegated group, because generic InputGroup control-slot rules do not target cmdk Input. This preserves the chosen 36px search row rather than wrapping the glyph onto a second row. List is listbox, Item is option, and cmdk Group heading selector is a stable upstream DOM attribute rather than a source-node identity. Highlight uses actual data-selected; optional caller data-checked check glyph is separate and source shortcut presence hides the glyph. No keyboard binding is created by shortcut text. The source CommandDialog places registered title/description siblings before Popup; this reference mounts on opening/unmounts after close completion, hides only that header visually and preserves its actual naming IDs. Modal focus/close/cancellation remain delegated to Dialog; command-specific popup has zero inset and one-third physical centered placement, with narrow viewport bounded by Dialog. The explicitly enabled Close button retains its delegated physical-right placement, so the search input reserves 40px physical-right padding in both text directions. Theme and direction are application document context in this adapter because CommandDialog exposes className but no Popup dir/data-theme prop; leading CSS remains component-owned and source-independent. No fake aria-modal attribute or invented Root disabled/value veto is added. No-results text is an explicit readable status, and caller chooses to close palette after execution.
